title: A Stochastic Analysis Perspective on Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative modelling involves two complementary tasks: learning a probabilistic approximation of an unknown data distribution from observations, and designing a tractable mechanism for sampling from this approximation. We present a stochastic-analysis perspective on score-based generative models, connecting ideas from classical sampling theory, score estimation, and diffusion time reversal. We first explain how score functions link Langevin sampling with score matching, and how Gaussian smoothing leads to denoising score matching and multiscale sampling methods. We then emphasize the distinction between dynamics preserving a fixed distribution and dynamics transporting a prescribed family of marginals. This motivates a path-space treatment of diffusion time reversal. Finally, we connect the ideal reverse diffusion with practical generative algorithms.

translated_title: 扩散模型的随机分析视角
translated_abstract: 生成式建模包含两个互补的任务：从观测数据中学习未知数据分布的概率近似，以及设计一种可操作的机制来从该近似中进行采样。我们提出了一个关于基于分数的生成式模型的随机分析视角，将经典采样理论、分数估计和扩散时间反演的思想联系起来。我们首先解释了分数函数如何将朗之万采样与分数匹配联系起来，以及高斯平滑如何引出去噪分数匹配和多尺度采样方法。随后，我们强调了保持固定分布的动力学与传输给定边缘分布族的动力学之间的区别。这启发了从路径空间角度对扩散时间反演的处理方法。最后，我们将理想化的反向扩散与实际的生成算法联系起来。
tldr: 本文从随机分析的视角统一阐述基于分数的生成式模型，将经典采样理论、分数估计与扩散时间反演联系起来，并通过路径空间方法连接理想反向扩散与实际生成算法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a stochastic analysis perspective on score-based generative models, connecting classical sampling theory, score estimation, and diffusion time reversal, and links ideal reverse diffusion with practical generative algorithms through a path-space treatment.
